name: Pinterest
description: Parse Pinterest pin URLs and save the original image into your Bowerbird library.
author: Bowerbird Team
longDescription:
### Key Features
- **Pin URL import**: Paste any Pinterest pin URL (regional domains and pin.it short links included) and save the linked image.
- **Original rendition**: Pin pages are resolved to the original `i.pinimg.com/originals/...` image instead of saving a thumbnail or the HTML page.
- **Source URL preserved**: The pin page is stored as the item's source URL while the actual image is downloaded.
- **Inspector shortcut**: Items whose source URL is a Pinterest pin get a one-click **Save image** action.
- **Context menu**: Right-click the canvas and choose **Save Pinterest Pin…** from Plugin Actions.

notes: Resolve Pinterest pin pages to their original image and import into Bowerbird
Support pin.it short links and direct i.pinimg.com URLs
